answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 100 identities means 100 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the delta pair is tracked in the relic ledger, the lagoon audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward calls for answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 31%. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
